test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people are sitting in a straight row all facing towards north. E is not an immediate neighbour of M and N. N is also not an immediate neighbour of M. M is sitting 4th to the right of L. I is sitting on extreme right end of the row. N is sitting fourth to the left of B. P is sitting third to the left of M and second to the right of N. Who is sitting at extreme left ends?
solution:
Seven people are sitting in a straight row all facing towards north. 

1. E is not an immediate neighbour of M and N.

2. N is also not an immediate neighbour of M.

3. M is sitting 4th to the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f664e49b1e628402439be025e83d8878ee2dd4128c3c15dcfc1403c2da8fbbef.png] 

4. I is sitting on extreme right end of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d501077d8bcd51c98088d81637742c6895e501470c1cc1e4a6b7897ea2acfe4.png] 

5. N is sitting fourth to the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dae89d556961321c18f7327abfe337e38d9cc12ccfec4845f646794292472bd1.png] 

6. P is sitting third to the left of M and second to the right of N. 

If this is the arrangement of P, then case 1 will not be further applicable, thus **case 2 **is the correct arrangement of seven people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a74e596377ffe62060e647e37ae452f011c12ea0a864442be90145a9cfa8da7d.png] 

7. As, E is not an immediate neighbour of M and N. The final arrangement of seven people is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c814a1bde29de4f649001aa3c67024d62a4ddb7b66585ff9043cd0393b45dcf3.png] 

Thus, **N **is sitting at extreme left ends.

Hence, the correct answer is** Option (1).**
